title: DDN art pack (ddn-art-pack@1)
description: Normative schema for a DDN art pack: a single self-contained JSON document pairing a manifest (identity, license, attribution, source) with detailed presentation illustrations (arbitrary viewBoxes, full colour) that declare their relation connection anchors and per-item provenance. See standard/specification/50-art-packs.md for the prose specification, including the sanitization requirements every consumer must enforce.

id.description: Pack namespace: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, an @-separator and a numeric major version. Items are referenced as <pack-id>/<item-id>.

version.description: Semantic version of the pack document. Item removals, renames, anchor moves or anchor-shifting artwork changes require a new pack major version (a new @N id), never an in-place edit.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the dominant (most restrictive) item license in the pack.

attribution.description: Copyright holder and project credit as it must appear in derivative notices.

source.description: Canonical upstream location of the artwork collection (URL or repository path).

licenseText.description: Full license text. Required whenever the license demands redistribution of the text; CC0/public-domain packs omit it.

note.description: Free-form scope note: curation stance, disclaimers, omissions.

id.description: Item identifier, unique within the pack.

svg.description: Complete inline SVG document, self-contained (no external references, scripts, event handlers or foreignObject — consumers reject it otherwise). At most 64 KiB.

anchors.description: Relation connection points in viewBox coordinates: the four side anchors plus any number of named anchors.

tags.description: Free-form classification for search and curation.

title.description: Upstream work title (file name or artwork name).

license.description: SPDX identifier for this item's artwork.

source.description: Canonical URL of the exact upstream file.

retrieved.description: ISO date the item was fetched and license-verified.

point.description: An [x, y] point in viewBox coordinates.
